title: Mos-Gen: A Generative Molecular Framework for Mosquito Insecticide Design
abstract: arXiv:2606.01846v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mosquito-borne infectious diseases cause more than 700000 deaths worldwide each year. The long-term use of conventional chemical insecticides has induced serious resistance problems, creating an urgent need to develop novel, highly effective, and ecologically sustainable alternatives. While existing artificial intelligence approaches in this domain have focused primarily on activity prediction and classification, they leave a critical gap in the de~novo generation of novel molecular scaffolds. In this study, we propose Mos-Gen, a motif-aware generative collaborative framework that couples the pretrained molecular representation model Uni-Mol with a variational autoencoder (VAE), specifically tailored for the design of disulfide-containing allicin derivatives as mosquito insecticides. translated_title: Mos-Gen：一种用于蚊虫杀虫剂设计的生成性分子框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.01846v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：蚊媒传染病每年在全球造成超过70万人死亡。传统化学杀虫剂的长期使用已引发严重的抗药性问题，迫切需要开发新型、高效且生态可持续的替代品。尽管该领域现有的人工智能方法主要集中于活性预测和分类，但在新分子骨架的从头生成方面仍存在关键空白。在本研究中，我们提出了Mos-Gen，一种基于基序感知的生成性协作框架，将预训练分子表示模型Uni-Mol与变分自编码器（VAE）相结合，专门用于设计含二硫键的大蒜素衍生物作为蚊虫杀虫剂。在生成的候选物中，选取了14种化合物（包括9种预测阳性和5种预测阴性）用于化学合成。
tldr: 本文提出Mos-Gen框架，结合Uni-Mol和VAE，首次实现针对蚊虫杀虫剂的新型含二硫键大蒜素衍生物的从头分子生成，填补了该领域生成设计空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Mos-Gen, a framework combining Uni-Mol and VAE, enabling the first de novo generation of novel disulfide-containing allicin derivatives as mosquito insecticides, filling the generative design gap in this field.
